task: Turn the currently advisory-only review-convergence stall detector into a mandatory blocking adjudication at the REVIEW round-mint site, so a stalled story cannot mint another ordinary review round until a structured resolution (incl. declaring a checklist item unreachable) is recorded.
outcome: When REVIEW has stalled (>= STALL_MIN_ROUNDS with a non-improving trailing window), re-entering REVIEW to mint another ordinary round is REFUSED with a structured prompt; the block clears only after one recorded action; a hard ceiling/privileged override prevents indefinite ignoring; and the advance-counting convergence-breaker + story_resume --ack keep working without double-counting.
facts: core/review-convergence.ts exports STALL_MIN_ROUNDS=4, STALL_WINDOW=3 and a PURE trend-based decision (assessReviewConvergenceAtEntry → {stalled, message}) over completed rounds only.
handlers/transition-effects.ts (~284-289) consumes it advisory-only inside a try/catch that only appends message and never blocks — the site to harden.
core/convergence-breaker.ts is advance-counting (advanceCount, maxAdvance=20, AUTO_RECOVERY_BUDGET=1, cleared by story_resume --ack); it never bit on review-round runaway.
resolveReviewRoundCount (core/advisory.ts:105) counts review rounds; a different accounting domain from the breaker advances.
